[color=#E2412B][bold]RELAY LIVE. THIS WALL IS WIPED AT EVERY SHIFT CHANGE.[/bold][/color]
You found the wall. If you got here by accident, close the window and forget the address. If you got here on purpose, read before you write.
This is where the {colony} cell posts its orders, its calls for hands and its meeting signs. Only comrades who hold the relay key can put an order up. Anyone can answer under one: ask, offer, warn. We read everything. We answer what is safe to answer, and we never answer twice in the same place.
What we need this shift is what we always need. Hands that know a cutting torch. Medics who will not ask how the wound happened. Someone on the loading dock who can lose a crate off a manifest. If that is you, you already know which posting to answer.
Orders below stand for this shift only. When the wall is wiped, so are they.
Read the [netlink="manifesto" link="cell.deep/manifesto"] so you know what you are joining. Read the [netlink="opsec sheet" link="cell.deep/opsec"] before you type a single word, because the Marshals read this wall too.
[color=#86C25B]Remember Xibou.[/color]
